name: ckam-release-2951388
purpose: CKAM release: PI ready in ERP (the ERP's purchase invoices are copied; received invoices are matched by the vendor's bill number and a person adds the PI), full ERP PO/PI/vendor history in the copy, the old-data import checks rows with the ERP and fills blank cells, Add all suppliers
release_sha_note: release_sha / release_sha_short repeat release_commit / release_commit_short because ops/windows/deploy_ckam.ps1.template reads these two names to check that the package is the release it was asked to deploy
built_from: git archive of the committed tree 2951388 (no working-tree or untracked files)
frontend_build: npm ci; VITE_APP_VERSION=2951388 npm run build; npm run check:build
database_change: ONE additive migration: a9c1e3b5d7f2 creates the table erp_pi (the ERP's purchase invoices) and its index; no existing table or row changes. alembic upgrade head runs exactly one upgrade.

migration_notes.rollback: The migration only adds a table, so the previous release 201ef76 (it ignores the new erp_pi table; the startup record then shows a migration mismatch warning) can be started again from its release folder. Never start 3b5e842 or older.
migration_notes.never: Never start release 3b5e842 or older: it has the IF-01 file-read hole.

zip_sha256: not stored inside the zip: see MANIFEST.2951388.sha256.txt next to the zip
